iconicAnchor.label: Internet-born vaporwave audiovisual collage
iconicAnchor.creatorOrTradition: Early-2010s vaporwave music and visual culture
iconicAnchor.whyCanonical: Peer-reviewed research identifies vaporwave as an internet nexus of music, video, and memes that reworks 1980s consumer electronics, commercial spaces, and mediated nostalgia.

sources.title: Vaporwave Aesthetics: Internet Nostalgia and the Utopian Impulse
supports: Vaporwave emerged through internet videos, memes, and experimental music and is tied to 1980s consumer electronics and commercial mediascapes.
Its nostalgia is ambivalent and often focuses on disorienting commercial non-places rather than simple retro celebration.

sources.title: Anemoia and the Vaporwave Phenomenon: the New Aesthetic of an Imagined Nostalgia
supports: Vaporwave emerged through the internet and operates as a visual as well as musical language.
It draws on imagined nostalgia, sampling, and the digital landscape of the 1990s.
